actual_scope: Every nonzero free P112 rectangle with at least two rows and two columns, coherently mixed with any two coordinate terms by GL(3,C); the other six coordinate terms are unchanged.
scope_change_reason: The initial unrestricted singleton-column scope overlapped Discussion1434. A single pivot to two-column corrections gave a finite two-anchor span-preservation lemma, which also covers every rectangle with at least two indices on each side. No second mechanism or coefficient search was introduced.
bottleneck_link: Tests whether masked rank-one corrections can reduce the binding complex supplier separate COPY power bill. The bound grants all additional physical costs zero and rules out this specified COPY-saving route.
stop_rule: At most nine minutes orientation; one overlap-driven pivot. Stop synthesis if the optimistic complete COPY bill cannot improve. Reserve final quarter for verification and handoff.
evidence: README.md contains the quantified proof; CERTIFICATE.json and INDEPENDENT.json carry exact finite-premise checks; verify.py and independent_check.py replay with semantic controls.
